name: Exp_DecEMA
summary: This EA trades based on the DecEMA (Decimal EMA) custom indicator, opening buy positions when the DecEMA value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses a crossover of three consecutive DecEMA buffer values to detect trend direction changes and applies configurable money management for position sizing with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于DecEMA（十进制EMA）自定义指标进行交易，当DecEMA值转向上时开多仓，转向下时开空仓。它通过三个连续DecEMA缓冲区值的交叉来检测趋势方向变化，并使用可配置的资金管理进行仓位管理，设有固定止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用DecEMA指标的方向变化来捕捉趋势的转折点。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标下降）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值回升）时，视为上升趋势开始，开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标上升）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值回落）时，视为下降趋势开始，开空仓。出场条件依赖固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时当反向信号出现时会先平掉反向持仓再开新仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损保证金比例、亏损余额比例和固定手数五种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化函数来执行开平仓操作，确保交易逻辑的一致性。策略默认在H8周期运行，使用SignalBar=1意味着基于上一根已收盘K线的信号进行交易，避免未完成K线的信号抖动。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to capture trend reversals using directional changes in the DecEMA indicator. Entry conditions are: when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator declining) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value rising), an uptrend is detected and a buy position is opened; when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator rising) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value falling), a downtrend is detected and a sell position is opened. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), and when a reverse signal appears, the opposing position is closed before opening a new one. Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-free margin percentage, loss-balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management uses standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library to execute open and close operations, ensuring consistency in trading logic. The strategy defaults to H8 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1, meaning signals are based on the last closed bar to avoid signal flickering from incomplete bars.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（按自由保证金/余额/亏损保证金/亏损余额/固定手数）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=上一根已收盘K线）
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0=current bar, 1=last closed bar)

pros: 使用自定义DecEMA指标，平滑效果优于普通EMA，减少虚假信号
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同资金管理需求
止损止盈配置完善，风险控制参数明确
支持独立开关多空方向的开仓和平仓，灵活性高
使用SignalBar=1基于已收盘K线信号，避免信号反复
pros_en: Uses custom DecEMA indicator with better smoothing than standard EMA, reducing false signals
Provides five position sizing modes for flexible money management
Complete stop loss and take profit configuration with clear risk control parameters
Independent on/off switches for buy/sell opening and closing offer high flexibility
Uses SignalBar=1 based on closed bar signals, preventing signal flickering
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，在多数品种上风险敞口极高
没有持仓数量检查，可能同时持有多个同方向仓位导致过度开仓
缺乏点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利成交
依赖外部自定义指标DecEMA和两个include库文件，部署复杂度较高
没有回撤保护机制，连续亏损时无减速或暂停逻辑
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, creating huge risk exposure on most instruments
No position count check, potentially allowing multiple same-direction positions leading to overexposure
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may execute at unfavorable prices during high-spread periods
Depends on external custom indicator DecEMA and two include library files, increasing deployment complexity
No drawdown protection mechanism; no slowdown or pause logic during consecutive losses
improvements: 添加最大持仓数量限制和同方向单仓检查，防止过度开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免不利条件下开仓
添加回撤保护机制，当账户回撤超过阈值时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add maximum position count limit and same-direction position check to prevent overexposure
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Add drawdown protection mechanism to pause trading when account drawdown exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，单笔亏损可能占账户很大比例
没有持仓数量检查，存在过度开仓风险
缺乏点差过滤，高点差时可能造成额外滑点损失
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stop loss is very large, a single loss could represent a significant portion of the account
No position count check creates risk of overexposure from multiple same-direction positions
Lack of spread filter may cause additional slippage losses during high-spread periods
